name: Travel Packing List
description: Generate trip lists from editable templates by people/days, assign owners and bags, and track packing progress with weight estimates; fully offline
help: Create a trip with people and days, then generate items from built-in templates; per-person/per-day quantity rules are computed in Rust and shared items are never doubled automatically.
Assign an owner, a bag and an optional per-item weight; items marked as excluded do not count toward progress; split one item across bags by creating separate entries.
Weight totals separate known from unknown: packed items without a weight are counted as an incomplete estimate, never treated as zero; weights are informational only, not airline or customs advice.
Trips and templates persist in the local ToolForge database; editing a template never changes created trips, and you can save templates or duplicate trips for the next journey.

input.name: Item
input.empty: Generate from a template or add items manually

result.title: Packing board
result.incomplete: Incomplete estimate: {{count}} packed items without weight

errors.plc.packed_range: Packed count cannot exceed the target (max {{max}})

checklist.summary: Work out how many of each item to pack for the group and trip length, with an estimated weight
checklist.items: Each item as "name:quantity[:rule][:grams each]"; empty rule = shared, p = per person, d = per day, pd = both
